origin.description: Equally spaced values from the range of a vector.
origin.usage: seq_range(x, n, by, trim = NULL, expand = NULL, pretty = FALSE)

arguments.name: by
arguments.text: Step. Only one of n and by may be set.

arguments.name: trim
arguments.text: Each tail is this fraction of the values, using quantile type 7.

arguments.name: expand
arguments.text: Grow the range by this fraction of its width, split across the two ends.

arguments.name: pretty
arguments.text: Snap the ends to R's pretty breaks.

origin.details: pretty is the base pretty sequence, with steps of 1, 2, and 5 times a power of ten. A pretty step snaps the ends with floor and ceiling. Asking for both n and by is an error.
